conditions: A processor is processing a document under XML 1.0 Fifth Edition.
limitations: The source imposes separate input normalization rules. An additional obligation to identify white space in element content applies to validating processors.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, correction, or material counterexample.

statement: XML 1.0 Fifth Edition requires an XML processor to pass non-markup document characters to the application, subject to the specification’s input normalization.
